text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... This year's TakarazukaKinen... is gonna be held... in Kyoto!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's right after the spring Tenno... so<n>the track'll be
all beat up! ...And<n>that's gonna make the race real
demanding!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Ryan. So even on your days<n>off you come
and train at the gym,<n>then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright! Yep, well, the big day's<n>coming up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hard work doesn't always get you<n>results. But if
you want to win, you do<n>have to work hard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want you and Dober to<n>come watch
the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I've prepped a present for you both.<n>And I can give
it to you at the<n>Takarazuka.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Of course. The two of us will<n>absolutely be there to
see you shine.<n>And I imagine we'll learn something
from it as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But if I end up losing after getting<n>your hopes up...
Sorry in advance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Oh, Ryan. Your jests are<n>terribly funny, you
know.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The day of the Takarazuka Kinen<n>arrives.

text_block_list.name: Spectator in Suit
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, but what time does Ines<n>Fujin's race
begin today?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's the main race for today, so<n>it won't start
until after 3:30! Are you<n>one of Fu's fans, then?

text_block_list.name: Spectator in Suit
text_block_list.text:
Well... Yes, I am. I'd very much like to<n>cheer her on
at a real racecourse, you<n>see.

text_block_list.name: Spectator in Suit
text_block_list.text:
...In truth, she's my subordinate. She<n>works
part-time in our delivery<n>department.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Really?! She works at my<n>place, too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What?! No way! My boss at the<n>ramen shop and
my manager at my<n>part-time job are getting
buddy-buddy?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So they hit it off here at the venue and<n>now they're
supporting me from the<n>stands... How does that
even<n>happen?!
choice_data_list: It's nice of them to come all the way out to Kyoto.
It's nice of them to come all the way out to Kyoto.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm just surprised that they'd<n>both make the
trip just to cheer me<n>on!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(But if they're here because they're<n>dreaming
through me too, then...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...I can't let them down.
choice_data_list: Let everyone's support be your strength!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, you're right! I'm gonna do<n>just that!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (Ryan and McQueen are both racing<n>today.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (But so am I...)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Here they come!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: McQueeeeen! Ryaaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I don't even need a good look at<n>Ryan to tell how
much stronger she's<n>gotten since the spring Tenno
Sho...<n>Those muscles are intense.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(And it's not just her physical<n>strength that's
improved. She's way<n>more focused, too...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen isn't the only runner in the<n>Mejiro family!
And at the Takarazuka<n>Kinen, I, Mejiro Ryan, will
show you<n>that I'm not to be ignored!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Gulp.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(And it's not just her physical<n>strength that's
improved. She's way<n>more focused, too...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen isn't the only runner in the<n>Mejiro family!
And at the Takarazuka<n>Kinen, I, Mejiro Ryan, will
show you<n>once again that I'm not to be ignored!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Gulp.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ines! I'm looking forward to...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh! Haha, good point.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Gotta start with a handshake... I'm<n>not going to
lose, you know.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Me neither!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two competitors share a firm<n>handshake as the
curtains rise on the<n>Takarazuka Kinen!
